messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling deploy started for service=runtime v=3.14.2 -> 3.15.0 on canary slice 'us-west-2a' :rocket:
sara_dev: heading into the canary watch window, watching p95 and error-rate
alex_oncall: seeing p95 jump on canary nodes already, +120ms vs baseline :thinking_face:
mike_runtime: confirmed, kernel fallback triggered on 2/3 canary hosts, threads spiking in logs
ops-bot: CPU saturation alert (host: r-w2a-c01) — 92% — suspected kernel fallback path
sara_dev: stacktrace snippet from canary logs:
```
2024-08-12T14:12:03Z runtime: kernel FallbackHandler invoked
kv_cache: miss-rate spike -> batching path fallback
batcher: window shrink to 5ms
```
alex_oncall: customer impact check — any 5xxs or large tail latencies?
customer_ops: inbound: two paying customers reported slow responses and timeouts on embeddings route, escalated to SEs :rotating_light:
liz_pm: which feature flags changed in this release? we toggled prefetch_affinity=true in canary only
mike_runtime: that flag changes prefetch affinity kernels and batch window heuristics — plausible cause
sara_dev: trying a selective flip: `ffctl set prefetch_affinity=false --env canary --slice us-west-2a`
deploy-bot: Feature flag update queued: prefetch_affinity=false (target: canary us-west-2a)
alex_oncall: flipping now, will monitor for reversion in p95 and kernel fallback logs
ops-bot: deploy rollback recommendation: if no improvement in 5m, revert rollout to v=3.14.2 for canary
incident-bot: paging oncall escalation: alex_oncall -> on-call 2ndline (mike_runtime) at 2m remaining
mike_runtime: confirmed, I'm on it. Pulling live KV-cache metrics and batcher histograms
sara_dev: metrics: batch size dropped from median 12 -> 2, per-token latency up 80% for canary slice
alex_oncall: after flag flip p95 down slightly but still 40ms above baseline; kernel fallback still emits intermittently
mike_runtime: hypothesis: small code path change in quantized kernel selection with prefetch_affinity toggles some kernels to fallback mode under certain seq lengths
sara_dev: we can hotfix by forcing kernel_affinity override to prefer stable kernel: `KERNEL_AFFINITY=legacy prefer` on canary nodes
liz_pm: customer comms: prepping a short note to affected customers, noting mitigation steps and ETA for rollback if needed
alex_oncall: decision: 1) keep flag off for canary 2) if p95 not within 20ms of baseline within 10m, rollback canary to v=3.14.2 and trigger staged rollback to full rollout pause
ops-bot: executing kernel_affinity override on canary nodes now
deploy-bot: Kernel affinity override applied to hosts r-w2a-c01,r-w2a-c02
sara_dev: observing p95 trending down, batch sizes recovering to median ~9, kernel fallback logs diminishing
customer_ops: two customers confirmed improvement, latencies back to normal on their side :thumbsup:
alex_oncall: good sign. keep watch for 20m window. mike, can you capture heap/profile for one host to follow up root cause?
mike_runtime: will run `strace + perf` and upload profiles to /artifacts/1719995555/ in 10m
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-1719995555 -> "canary runtime kernel fallback after prefaffinity change". Severity: P2.
liz_pm: will draft postmortem skeleton, linking to artifacts and timeline
alex_oncall: if reoccurs, we have rollback plan in place (rollback canary -> pause -> revert flag globally). For now, monitoring continues. :eyes:
